wrapup.intro: When this Agent is terminated due to timeout or exhausted turns, the system injects this "wrap-up prompt" for one wrap-up round: It first writes back anything identified but not yet stored, then outputs a one-line summary (to avoid an abrupt ending). Leave empty to use the built-in default.
wrapup.bodyPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the built-in default wrap-up prompt
wrapup.turnsLabel: Wrap-up turns (max turns for the wrap-up phase itself; 0 = built-in default of {n} turns)
wrapup.ttIntro: Task timeout wrap-up (separate from the per-run wrap-up above): injected when the entire task hits its timeout cap and is about to end. Its semantics are often the opposite of per-run (e.g. planner: per-run says "don't stop, keep planning", task timeout says "time's up, stop and make the final call"). Leave empty to use the built-in default.
wrapup.ttBodyPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the built-in default task timeout wrap-up prompt
wrapup.ttTurnsLabel: Wrap-up turns (0 = built-in default of {n} turns)

triggers.intro: Triggers make this custom Agent run automatically: each trigger starts a new conversation (visible on the Chat page). Multiple trigger conditions can be selected; the system automatically appends "why this fired + related task/finding/goal" to the base message you write.
triggers.policyLabel: Post-trigger handling policy (how triggers are queued/merged to run)
triggers.policyDescParallel: Parallel: each trigger immediately starts its own concurrent session, no merging; triggers beyond the max concurrency queue for a free slot.
triggers.policyDescByTask: Serial · merge by task: one run at a time per agent; queued events for the same task merge into one conversation.
triggers.policyDescAll: Serial · merge all: one run at a time per agent; when dequeuing, all currently queued triggers merge into one conversation.
triggers.policyDescNone: Serial · no merge: one run at a time per agent; each trigger gets its own conversation.
triggers.newLabel: New trigger (each condition can have its own user message)
triggers.schedulePlaceholder: Message sent to the agent when the schedule fires, e.g. inspect all tasks
triggers.findingPlaceholder: Message sent to the agent when a finding is found (the system attaches task and finding details)
triggers.goalPlaceholder: Message sent to the agent when a goal is met (the system attaches the task and the met goal)
triggers.taskTimeoutPlaceholder: Message sent to the agent on task timeout (the system attaches the task id and goals)
triggers.toolWatchHelp: Select the tools to watch (at least one); each time these tools finish a call during task execution, a trigger fires. {n} selected.
triggers.toolCallPlaceholder: Message sent to the agent when a tool is called (the system attaches task info, tool input and output)
triggers.taskCreatePlaceholder: Message sent to the agent when a task is created (the system attaches the task id and goals)

toasts.selectCondition: Select at least one trigger condition
toasts.toolRequired: Tool-call triggers require at least one tool
